scope: Fixed-profile, graphed single-GPU decode used by this campaign
offloaded: DONE trailing counter: routed entries computed by GPU from outside its local cache (PCIe/direct or peer); not CPU fallback.
cpu_routed_entries: lookups - hits, because fixed-profile token graph admits no entries during a token and its refused entries are dispatched to CPU pool. Counts token/expert entries, not distinct experts or jobs.
